blocks.text:
The Upper Circuit is about 1,300 metres long. Its walkways cross above the river, letting you see where the calm water suddenly plunges down. Adam and Eve are among the notable falls on this section.

**Duration:** about 1 hour.  
**Difficulty:** easy, with a step-free ascent.

blocks.text:
This is the most powerful section of the route. Water drops from a height of 82 metres and disappears into a cloud of spray. You can hear its roar before the walkway brings you to the edge of the falls. The Ecological Train and a network of walkways take you almost to the point where the water plunges down.

If the Argentine side of the falls is closed at the time of your trip, this excursion will be replaced by the Macuco Safari.

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, transfer to the airport and flight to Manaus. On arrival, transfer to your lodge in the Amazon. Dinner and a night canoe tour to spot caimans by torchlight (all excursions with an English-speaking guide).

Please note: arrive in Manaus on flights landing before 13:00 to join the regular transfer, and leave on flights departing after 14:00; otherwise a private transfer is charged by the lodge.
